displayDescription.en:
BenchCouncil lists InstructGPT in the LLM area of its AI100 (2022-2023) annual table. It associates the work with the publication “Training language models to follow instructions with human feedback”. The page names Long Ouyang, Jeff Wu, Xu Jiang, Diogo Almeida, Carroll L. Wainwright, Pamela Mishkin, Paul Christiano, Jan Leike, Ryan Lowe as the main contributors.

This Archive record preserves the official row order, citation value, institution, and country fields. It represents the annual 2022-2023 selection and remains separate from the long-term canonical AI100 storyline.
